implemented: Optional startFoundations local entry binder: main-process source verifier supplies current user/entry identity and gates; operation descriptors are closed-schema snapshots; request identity lives in a WeakMap and cannot be serialized/copied into a valid binding.

Source close permanently invalidates that source in the current binder. Entry-generation advance invalidates previous bindings and requires a fresh exact permission grant. Derived requests preserve source identity and generation across verification calls.

Known local tokens never fall back to unrelated legacy TrustPort facts; when a local binder is configured, raw local facts in the legacy path are rejected. Existing nonlocal TrustPort behavior is retained.

Optional Space assembly uses the Space public interface and the real permissions reader. Space borrows only the app-owned public-root lease; Context roots still acquire their own actual locks. Default per-object projection requests derive through the local binder.

Host stop synchronously seals local binding and permission reads/management, drains domain work, closes stores, and releases the root lease only after confirmed cleanup. Space failures and initialization orphan stores remain retryable and retain the root lease.
App holds no Context/permission/Operation business-state replicas and issues no default grants.
